Package nxt

Class FundingMonitor

java.lang.Object
nxt.FundingMonitor
public final class FundingMonitor extends Object
Monitor account balances based on account properties

GALA, ASSET and CURRENCY balances can be monitored. If a balance falls below the threshold, a transaction will be submitted to transfer units from the funding account to the monitored account. A transfer will remain pending if the number of blocks since the previous transfer transaction is less than the monitor interval.

    • startMonitor

      public static boolean startMonitor(HoldingType holdingType, long holdingId, String property, long amount, long threshold, int interval, String secretPhrase)
      Start the monitor

      One or more funding parameters can be overridden in the account property value string: {"amount":"long","threshold":"long","interval":integer}

      Parameters:
      holdingType - Holding type
      holdingId - Asset or currency identifier, ignored for GALA monitor
      property - Account property name
      amount - Fund amount
      threshold - Fund threshold
      interval - Fund interval
      secretPhrase - Fund account secret phrase
      Returns:
      TRUE if the monitor was started
